Elena (Solaris): Hi Redwood — Solaris is ready to onboard a custom claims summarizer. It's a finetuned 13B (open) model we plan to run quantized to 8-bit. Requirements: PHI-safe handling, HSM for key material, VPC-only deployment, and pre-production safety evals. Timeline aim: start Q2. Can you confirm next steps? cc @Maria (CS)
Maria (CS): Thanks @Elena — we'll take point. Quick clarifying q's: 1) Will any training data leave your VPC? 2) Expected peak qps and latency SLO? 3) Do you need Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) or Dedicated?
Elena (Solaris): All inference data must stay inside our VPC. We can share sample payloads. Peak expected ~500 qps, but initial canary ~20 qps. Latency target <= 350ms p95 if possible. We prefer Private (VPC) with HSM.
Maria (CS): Got it. Looping in Priya for safety/evals, Jae for deployment format + ops, Omar for security/HSM, Lin for rollout coordination.
Priya (ML): Welcome — for safety we'll need a small prompt set to test PHI leakage and hallucination risk. Suggested deliverables from customer: ~1k red-team prompts, 500 benign prompts, and 200 labeled ground-truth summaries if available. We'll run: - leakage scans - hallucination/faithfulness bench - ROUGE/BLEU + custom policy checks. Can Solaris provide data via secure S3 (VPC endpoint) or encrypted artifact?
Elena (Solaris): We can provide a scrubbed sample set via secure S3 presigned URL (VPC endpoint). Full dataset requires our legal OK; will aim to share scrubbed 1k in 48 hours.
Jae (Solutions): A few deployment notes: please confirm model artifact format (HF .pt, safetensors, or gguf). If quantized to 8-bit, send the exact quantization recipe (tool/version). KV cache pattern? Are you using long contexts (>4k)? For Private we'll need the model artifact and a checksum. Example filenames we expect: `claims_summarizer_v1.safetensors` and `claims_summarizer_v1.q8.gguf`
Elena (Solaris): artifact will be `claims_summarizer_v1.safetensors`; quantized with intel/q8-recipe v0.9. Contexts typically 2k max.
Omar (Security): HSM + KMS is noted. We'll need: - SOC2 attestation from Solaris infra team if they host KMS - KMS key policy to allow Redwood Private runtime access (least privilege) - data residency region (which cloud/region) Also: does Solaris require customer-managed HSM or is cloud KMS sufficient?
Elena (Solaris): We require customer-managed HSM (Azure Key Vault HSM). Region: eu-west-1. We'll share SOC2 excerpt.
Lin (EngOps): I'll open a project card and schedule a kickoff. Proposed rollout: 1) ingest & eval (Priya) 2) private deploy in staging (Jae) 3) safety canary (5% traffic, 24h) 4) ramp to 25% then 100%. I'll add a checklist with owners.
deploy-bot: Created task https://rwd.company/tasks/77421 "Solaris claims summarizer intake" and assigned Maria, Priya, Jae, Omar, Lin :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): Capturing renewal risk note: Solaris is evaluating Dedicated vs Private; strong perf & security will push them to a multi-year Dedicated commit. We'll capture enablement feedback during the kickoffs to feed the renewal motion.
Elena (Solaris): Thanks — sample data ETA 48h, SOC2 excerpt coming, prefer kickoff next Wed 10am UTC.
Priya (ML): Once we have the sample set, we estimate 3 business days to run initial safety/eval bench and deliver a short report with recommended guardrails (response filters, prompt sanitizers, and policy thresholds).
Omar (Security): If customer-managed HSM is required, expect ~2 weeks for key provisioning and policy verification on our side. Flagging as potential schedule risk.
Lin (EngOps): Noted. Next actions for Redwood: - Maria to collect SOW + legal contact - Jae to confirm artifact acceptance + staging infra - Priya to prepare eval harness and red-team templates - Omar to start HSM onboarding checklist - Lin to schedule kickoff and create project board
Maria (CS): @Elena I'll DM you SOW template and request for legal contact. Also FYI I'll capture enablement materials you want in the handoff. :handshake:
Elena (Solaris): Sounds good — appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to kickoff.
Jae (Solutions): Small ops tip: if you can provide a small perf profile (latency per token) from your local tests we can pre-size the Dedicated pool more accurately.
Elena (Solaris): I'll ask infra for the perf CSV and share.
Maria (CS): Great. We'll reconvene after the sample data arrives. Thanks everyone :rocket:
